description: Public UI endpoints used by the Sam Rogers AI-queryable resume.

graceful_boundaries.maintainer_note: Sam Rogers authored and maintains the Graceful Boundaries specification.

guidecheck.maintainer_note: Sam Rogers authored and maintains the GuideCheck specification.

privacy.summary: The fit assessment and chat endpoints receive user-supplied text for analysis by the configured cloud LLM provider. The current production provider is Anthropic. Submitted text is not intentionally stored by this app. Users should not paste confidential, proprietary, regulated, or unreleased role data; they should email sensitive roles to sam@sam-rogers.com instead.

endpoints.purpose: Expose machine-readable public API limits for Graceful Boundaries Level 2 discovery.
Answer user questions about Sam Rogers' resume, evidence, gaps, portfolio, and role fit.
Compare a pasted job description against Sam Rogers' profile and return an honest role-fit assessment.

openapi.reason: These endpoints support the website UI rather than a public integration API.
